critical_code_review_comments: iter8 tests TestCheckoutTransferGroup.test_session_has_transfer_group + TestTransferDeferredPath.test_deferred_when_maker_has_no_stripe_account use the deprecated 'asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete()' which raises RuntimeError when no current loop exists in the main thread (any prior asyncio.run() closes the default loop). Recommend converting to asyncio.run(_check()) or @pytest.mark.asyncio for forward-compat — currently they only pass in isolation. Cosmetic but will become a Python 3.12+ hard-fail.

AdminDashboard.jsx PaidOrdersList relies solely on window.confirm() to prevent double-refund. The button itself disables only while refunding state is set (single-fire), which is fine, but consider also disabling all refund buttons on the row once initiated (not just self) to remove ambiguity if backend lag occurs. Idempotency on the server already guards against double-refund, so this is defensive only.

CommunityPage.jsx ThreadDetail polling uses 12s interval — fine for chat parity, but for a thread with sustained activity this can grow expensive. Recommend pausing polling when document.hidden=true, and resuming on visibilitychange. (Not blocking.)

Iter8 transfer_group mismatch flagged in iteration_7.json is STILL present in /app/backend/routers/stripe_connect.py — Transfer.create uses session_id but PaymentIntent uses pre_transfer_group (uuid). For separate-charge-and-transfer to work in production, these must match. The deferred-path tests pass because they don't exercise the actual Transfer.create. Re-flagged here for E1.
